reviews.title: Great cooler from PCCOOLER...
reviews.comment: The PCCOOLER 360mm AIO cooler is a great bargain that works really well. The IPS display is a nice touch easy to change backgrounds with the software that you download from their sight. The IPS display is nice and bright so the image never appears washed out or blurry. The pump is super quiet, and the fans are really high performance. When browsing the internet or watching videos the fans run at around 800 RPM. The CPU stays under 37C. The fans only get noticeably louder under demanding gaming or video editing with a top RPM north of 2200 RPM. At that top of the curve the fans are moving 90 CFM each. That's a lot of air. The pump seems to run a constant 2500RPM. I don't understand why the pump runs that fast.  There is a four pin connector, this should enable ramping up and down? It may need tweaking in the BIOS. The CUP is Ryzen 9 7950X3D running at 100%  Temperatures are never above 73C that's 165 F well under the 80 c- 89c in AMD literature.  At 89 C the CUP starts to throttle. The radiator is well made Mine is painted black. One other nice touch is the fans are daisy changed into one fan connector and installed on the radiator in the pull position. All in all a great buy for under $80.00. Well worth it...
reviews.author: IPDAILY

reviews.title: Performance That Defies the Price Tag
reviews.comment: I bought this to replace another brand that failed in less than a year. At first, I was hesitant because of its lower-than-expected price, but the same-day delivery convinced me to give it a try. I’m glad I did. The unit is very well made, with everything you need included. Packaging was solid, and the instructions were straightforward enough to make installation simple. Wiring was equally easy. Performance-wise, it’s impressive. Once you take the time to set up your fan curves properly, it delivers excellent cooling. I’m using it on my 13900KS, overclocked past 6 GHz, and temps barely reach 90°C. That’s remarkable. The customizable graphics are a nice bonus—you can even upload your own display image. The only drawback is the software, which occasionally glitches. Closing and restarting it fixes the issue every time, so it’s more of a minor inconvenience than a dealbreaker. Overall, this cooler deserves 5 stars for its value, performance, and build quality.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Pretty great and decent aio for the price!
reviews.comment: I quite like this AIO. Its installation was simple, and once it was plugged all in, it was a perfect finishing touch on making my pc look nice. I have a 9600x amd cpu, and a m atx case that has 6 other fans. When I ran cinebench in, my highest cpu temp was 90c for a period of 10 minutes and the score was 16,753, which was pretty good and showing its cooling was pretty good, especially considering its price and comparing it to more expensive or name brand aios. The value for money is pretty great, and I would highly recommend it to any beginner to mid range build. The only downsides is while it it fantastic for cooling, it sounds like a jet engine constantly 😅 which is why I didn’t put 5 stars. Also, to download the software to customize the screen, it’s quite difficult to find the website and once you download the software, it’s a bit finicky to found out how to work it. I did get it to work eventually and was even able to upload a gif to it and customize the data that shows up on it. All in all, it’s a pretty great aio.

reviews.title: Excellent Price for an Aesthetic White AIO
reviews.comment: This cooler performs exceptionally well in low temperatures, both when operating under heavy workloads. The installation process was easy, and the quality of construction is high. The design is smooth and fits into a neat setup, particularly in white-themed setups. The price to performance is amazing, the fact that an AIO at this budget with a screen is an absolute steal.
